DiscrollView.java: extends ScrollView, single-child constraint, DiscrollViewContent required
DiscrollView.java: onScrollChanged iterates children index≥1, calculates ratio based on viewport position
DiscrollView.java: two trigger modes - center-reach (sufficient space) and top-reach (insufficient space)
DiscrollView.java: clamp(ratio, 0.0f, 1.0f) applied to all calculations
DiscrollViewContent.java: extends LinearLayout(VERTICAL), auto-wraps children with discrollve attrs into DiscrollvableView
DiscrollViewContent.LayoutParams: parses 7 XML custom attributes
Discrollvable.java: interface with onDiscrollve(float ratio) and onResetDiscrollve()
DiscrollvableView.java: extends FrameLayout, implements Discrollvable
DiscrollvableView.java: 6 transform types - alpha (setAlpha), scaleX (setScaleX), scaleY (setScaleY), translationX/Y (setTranslationX/Y), backgroundColor (ArgbEvaluator)
DiscrollvableView.java: translation direction bitmask (0x01=fromTop, 0x02=fromBottom, 0x04=fromLeft, 0x08=fromRight)
DiscrollvableView.java: withThreshold() remaps ratio: (ratio - threshold) / (1.0 - threshold)
DiscrollvableView.java: validates conflicting directions (top+bottom and left+right forbidden)
attrs.xml: 7 declare-styleable attributes + 4 translation flag values
